history.content: Hi! Let’s start with the basics—what are the length and width of your plot (in feet)?
Great, a 50 × 50 ft plot. How many bedrooms would you like?
and i want to build well i want 3 bhk home and 3 bathroom and a pooja room and a kitchen and a dinning hall and a spacious living room and a car parking
Got it—3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, plus the rooms you listed. Which direction would you like the main entrance to face (north, south, east, or west)?
Perfect, entrance facing south recorded. We have all required details now. Your brief is ready—click “Generate 3D home” to see the design, and let me know if you’d like any tweaks before generating.
